title: Daybreak Red and Blue on Amazon Bedrock
hook: Which OpenAI cyber defence models are now available on Amazon Bedrock?

back.lead: Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue from OpenAI are now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock. Both are part of Daybreak, the cyber defence initiative from OpenAI that gives defenders governed access to frontier AI for cybersecurity work.

kv.v: Starting point for most security teams across defensive workflows including vulnerability discovery, detection engineering, and incident response
